question: The term ‘Protozoa’ was coined by ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goldfuss**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term ''Protozoa'' was first coined by Goldfuss. It is the 3rd largest phylum
 
• Protozoa include single-celled organisms and all the biological activities like excretion, respiration, osmoregulation is performed by this single celled body only.
 
• The body performs all necessary biological activities so in them, a subcellular-physiological division of labour is found.
 
• Respiration and Excretion take place by the exchange of gases through the body surface. Nitrogenous waste is ammonia.
 
• Digestion in Protozoa is intracellular within food vacuoles
 
• Water absorption occurs through the invagination of the general body surface. This is called cell drinking or Pinocytosis 
 
• Contractile vacuole mainly serves for osmoregulation however, some excretion may also occur through the contractile vacuole.
